description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Check Athletics or Crafting, your choice, DC set by the GM

Strike a malfunctioning firearm, device, or piece of machinery you can touch. On a success it works normally for 1 minute regardless of its condition; on a critical success, for the rest of the encounter. On a critical failure it is broken until repaired at a workshop, and you knew that was possible when you swung.

cinderfall.incomplete: no selector for skill-check-gated item-state restoration (same reasoning as jury-rig-repair/field-conversion).
